semantic_meaning: Encircles the chokepoint node/edge to signal constrained capacity or control.
when_to_use: When a system reduces to a small number of critical nodes
When establishing a leverage constraint before consequences
when_not_to_use: As a generic highlight for any important item
On multiple nodes at once (unless explicitly comparing chokepoints)
If the claim is not about constraint/control

forbidden.multi_ring_decoration: Do not sprinkle rings as decoration.
forbidden.red: Do not use red unless showing consequence/failure/exposure.

animation_behavior.description: Ring draws on, tightens, and stabilizes; optional subtle scanline to imply constraint.

input_parameters.name: target_bounds
input_parameters.description: Bounding box of the chokepoint target.

state_beats.label: ring_tighten
state_beats.meaningful_change: Ring tightens/scales slightly to imply constraint.

expected_outputs: A single amber ring emphasizing the chokepoint
Beat labels suitable for cadence validation
validation_notes: Only one chokepoint ring per focal claim (unless explicitly comparing).
No beat may hold longer than 4 seconds without state change.
